pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions unless the initial entry is in profit by at least 3x the ATR with a locked breakeven stop.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 15-second volume delta confirmation and order-book imbalance threshold before executing any breakout entry on XAUUSD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00, trailing the remaining balance aggressively to capture up to +$30.00.
